note: Generic template — this skill does not carry a per-ConfigurationName mapping. Every entry runs through the same 5-step recipe. Replace only the documented placeholders; do not add per-type keys here. See references/api_endpoints.md for the walkthrough.

stepA_deriveCandidate.output: <Candidate> — one or two plausible Tooling API sobject names, using Salesforce knowledge (usually the singular of ConfigurationName, sometimes with a Workflow- prefix or -Proxy suffix)
stepA_deriveCandidate.note: Do not commit to a candidate here; Step B verifies against the live org.

acceptIf: response.fields[] contains an entry with name == 'Metadata'
stepB_describeVerify.note: Cache the verified sobject name per-ConfigurationName; do not re-describe on every entry.

uniqueFilterHints.rowExposesFullName: Filter by EntityDefinition.QualifiedApiName = '<Fields.Object>' when the entry has Fields.Object, then pick the row whose FullName == '<Fields.Object>.<Label>' client-side (SOQL cannot filter on FullName).
uniqueFilterHints.rowExposesQueryableUniqueField: Filter directly by that field = '<Label>' (e.g. SiteName, DeveloperName).

getCurrentMetadata.note: Preserve every key already in this block — the Metadata field is replace-in-full on PATCH.

fieldMapping.convention: camelCase (lowercase first letter of the config's Fields.<Xxx> key)
fieldMapping.exceptionsNote: Some ConfigurationName types rename fields between the customer-facing config and the Metadata API (e.g. RemoteSiteSettings.Fields.RemoteSiteUrl -> RemoteProxy.Metadata.url, not remoteSiteUrl). If the derived camelCase key is NOT present in the current Metadata block from the GET, mark the entry FIELD_MAP_UNKNOWN and stop.

bodyTemplate.Metadata: <the full block from GET, with mutated camelCase keys overwritten>

patch.failure: FAILED — capture the JSON error message

stepE_verify.channel: prefer SOQL SELECT by Id when the mutated field is a direct-queryable column; otherwise GET the record and inspect .Metadata.<mappedKey>

isActiveHandling.false: SKIPPED_INACTIVE — no PATCH; add a Follow-ups bullet to the summary

placeholders.<apiVersion>: vXX.0 from sf org display result.apiVersion
placeholders.<Candidate>: Step A output — one candidate Tooling sobject name
placeholders.<VerifiedSobject>: the candidate that passed Step B; cached per-ConfigurationName for the run
placeholders.<Id>: the record Id returned by Step C
placeholders.<UniqueFilter>: Step C filter derived from the sobject's queryable fields
placeholders.<mappedKey>: camelCase key inside the Metadata block, derived from Fields.<Xxx>
placeholders.<ConfigValue>: the value of Fields.<Xxx> from the config entry, sent verbatim
